target.statement: AgentOPSD (full method, turn-level bounded reshaping with λ=0.5) reaches 89.1% average success on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
target.table_ref: Table 1 (ALFWorld Avg column, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct row, AgentOPSD) and Table 2 (full row, 89.1)

compute.basis: The 89.1 number requires RL training Qwen2.5-7B for 150 steps on 8×H800 GPUs with group size 8 and up to 50-turn ALFWorld rollouts; it cannot be run on an 8-core/16 GB laptop, so the command-time estimate is effectively unbounded.

blockers: Requires 8×H800 GPUs or similar to train Qwen2.5-7B with RL; no CPU-only path
No released trained checkpoints, so the target must be retrained from scratch
Training depends on privileged skills retrieved from the external SkillBank of SkillRL
Long-horizon agentic rollouts (up to 50 turns) with vLLM/FSDP make the run far beyond laptop scale
title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
